rules.statement: A person in possession of land under a non-notarial writing purporting to be a lease for more than one month is not necessarily a trespasser, especially if there is evidence of a practice of paying rent in advance and an admission of a monthly tenancy.
rules.supporting_quote: "No document was here produced which purported to lease to the defendant or his predecessor the premises from which the plaintiffs seek to eject him. There was evidence that the father of the defendant had been in possession of the premises from 1947 until the time of his death in May 1963 and that he had sometimes paid Rs. 60 to the plaintiffs' predecessor Kalu Banda as rent in advance for a period of 12 months."
